name: gateway_sneak_gate_makes_it_unblockable
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever a Gate you control enters, this creature can't be blocked this turn. Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.' Seat 0 plays Azorius Guildgate: Gateway Sneak can't be blocked this turn, so Opp Bear is never asked to block it; it deals 1 combat damage to seat 1 and seat 0 draws a card (hand: the Guildgate played, then one card drawn).
